text.name: A Hefty Bream
text.description:
{A Hefty Bream}

Get slapped with a bream! And +1 to Attack!
text.event: A small stream crossed your path, so you stopped for a while to fish. A couple of minutes later a Hefty Bream was your catch. You thought it would be handy for giving someone a slap. No other fish bit that day.
